DirectX Shader Compiler (DXC), vendored so every platform compiles shaders with the same compiler.

Version : 1.9.0.5512 (commit 01b62ad4)
Source  : LunarG Vulkan SDK 1.4.363.0
License : LICENSE.TXT (University of Illinois/NCSA Open Source License)

Layout
  include/dxc/dxcapi.h, WinAdapter.h   <- VulkanSDK/1.4.363.0/macOS/include/dxc/
  macos/libdxcompiler.dylib            <- VulkanSDK/1.4.363.0/macOS/lib/        (universal arm64 + x86_64)
  win-x64/dxcompiler.dll, dxil.dll     <- C:/VulkanSDK/1.4.363.0/Bin/            (dxil.dll signs DXIL for D3D12)

Updating: install the new Vulkan SDK on both macOS and Windows, replace every file above from the
same SDK version at once, and update the version lines here. Never mix files from different versions.
